name: Sword of Life Stealing

source.note: Entered from knowledge of the 2024 DMG (personal build); check every number against the book.

summary: On a 20, an extra 3d6 Necrotic to a living target, and you gain that much in Temporary Hit Points.
text: Roll a 20 on an attack roll with this magic weapon against any creature other than a Construct or Undead and it suffers 3d6 extra Necrotic damage, and you receive that much extra damage as Temporary Hit Points.
